sentence: This project searches for small molecule compounds that bind core proteins of the circadian clock, to use as chemical probes in cancer.
This project studies the molecular signals that shape the aortic valve to find disease factors in congenital aortic valve defects.
This project provides stem cells, gene therapy and humanized mice for research on HIV infection and the human immune system.
This project studies how epigenetic regulation of a gene in sympathetic neurons affects sympathetic innervation, adipocyte thermogenesis and energy metabolism.
This project studies how neutralizing antibodies develop during peanut oral immunotherapy and why long-term tolerance occurs in only some people.
This project supports sleep research with study design, data collection, statistical programming and analysis.
This project builds a mass spectrometry imaging platform that detects tryptic peptides, prostaglandins and metals in tissue sections to find biomarkers of inflammation.
This project tries to find out how an ion channel protein works, including the mechanisms and networks behind its function.
This project builds a simple, gentle method to engineer natural killer cells for use in cancer treatments.
This project builds a smart sensor system that measures breath to monitor pulmonary exacerbations in children with cystic fibrosis.
This project provides biostatistical and bioinformatic support and a database for liver cancer research data.
This project builds and tests a skills course on tobacco use assessment and treatment for oncology care professionals.
This project tries to find out which signaling networks make proinflammatory T cells cause neuroinflammation.
This project studies the basic mechanisms behind diseases of the heart, vasculature and lungs in childhood.
This project develops small molecules that target a Rho GTPase controlling the immune response against tumor cells, for cancer immunotherapy.
This project studies why some brain regions are prone to degeneration in Alzheimer's disease models and whether connections between them matter.
This project studies how histone demethylases contribute to heart failure, using mouse models that gain or lose these proteins' function.
This project tests adenine base editor gene correction as a therapy for severe combined immune deficiency, using viral and nonviral delivery methods.
This project uses machine learning to describe how higher-order auditory cortex is organized.
This project examines how adolescents with co-occurring disorders use emotion regulation skills in an intensive outpatient treatment program.
